Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حُسْنِ قَضَائِكَ
Translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise for Your excellent decree
And for what You have averted from me of Your trials

Arabic text: فَلَا تَجْعَلْ حَظِّيْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ لِيْ مِنْ عَافِيَتِكَ
Translation: So do not make my share of Your mercy only what You have hastened for me of Your well-being

Arabic text: فَأَكُونَ قَدْ شَقِيتُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتُ وَ سَعِدَ غَيْرِيْ بِمَا كَرِهْتُ
Translation: For I would then be wretched with what I love, while others are blessed with what I dislike

Arabic text: وَإِنْ يَكُنْ مَا ظَلِلْتُ فِيهِ أَوْ بِتُّ فِيهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْعَافِيَةِ
Translation: And if what I have remained in or spent the night in of this well-being

Arabic text: بَيْنَ يَدَيْ بَلَاءٍ لَا يَنْقَطِعُ، وَوِزْرٍ لَا يَرْتَفِعُ
Translation: Is before a trial that does not end, and a burden that does not lift

Arabic text: فَقَدِّمْ لِيْ مَا أَخَّرْتَ وَأَخِّرْ عَنِّيْ مَا قَدَّمْتَ
Translation: Then bring forward for me what You have delayed, and delay from me what You have hastened
For not much is that which ends in extinction
And not little is that which ends in eternity
And send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
